rationale: Financial loss from runaway AI agent API spend is acute and well-documented across HN, Reddit, and dev forums, with multiple operators reporting real monetary damage. Existing cloud-native cost tools (AWS Budgets, GCP billing alerts) do not integrate with LLM API spend at the agent-task level, leaving a clear gap. At least one competitor (Helicone) charges for usage analytics, confirming willingness to pay for spend visibility in this space.
